EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT

This Exclusive Distribution Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of [Date] by and between:

Northfield Seating Inc., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware
Address: 2200 Harbor Avenue, Suite 400, Brooklyn, NY 11201, USA
(hereinafter "Supplier")

and

Hanbit Office Co., Ltd., a company incorporated in the Republic of Korea
Address: 12, Teheran-ro 100-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul 06100, Korea
(hereinafter "Distributor")

1. Appointment
1.1 Supplier appoints Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products in the Territory, and Distributor accepts such appointment.
1.2 "Territory" means the Republic of Korea.

2. Purchase Orders and Prices
2.1 Distributor shall purchase the Products by issuing Purchase Orders to Supplier. Prices shall be as set forth in Schedule A and are quoted in USD on an FCA Newark, Incoterms 2020 basis.
2.2 Distributor shall pay each invoice by T/T within forty-five (45) days after the date of the bill of lading.

3. Minimum Purchase
3.1 Distributor shall purchase Products of not less than USD 300,000 in each contract year.

4. Warranty
4.1 Supplier warrants that the Products shall be free from defects in material and workmanship for twelve (12) months after delivery.
4.2 Distributor shall inspect the Products within thirty (30) days after arrival and notify Supplier in writing of any defect.

5. Term and Termination
5.1 This Agreement shall remain in force for three (3) years from the date hereof.
5.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days after receipt of notice.

6. Force Majeure
6.1 Neither party shall be liable for any delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including war, natural disaster or port closure.

7. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
7.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
7.2 The courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.
Northfield Seating Inc.  By: ____________________  Name/Title: ____________________
Hanbit Office Co., Ltd.  By: ____________________  Name/Title: ____________________
